messages.subject: Shiny crash on runApp() for OS X 10.9.1
parts:
Hello, I sadly have this crash when trying to run the examples of Shiny on Mac OSX.  I have it running fine on Debian, but this is the first time I've tried on Mac.

Following the guide found at https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/blob/master/guide/guide.md I have reinstalled R, RStudio and have re-downloaded the packages involved.

However, when I try:

R> library(shiny)
R> runApp()

..Rstudio crashes saying "R Session Aborted" R encountered a fatal error

Trying

R> library(shiny)
R> runExample("01_hello")

...I get the same.

When I run the above in R standard, I get the below message dump, which I hope helps.

I can only add that I had some trouble when attempting to install packages before reinstalling R and RStudio, I got an error saying RStudio couldn't delete the old packages.  I chmod the folder to 755, and deleted the package folders myself in the folder specified, then downloaded the latest version of RStudio - perhaps this is related?  I did:

> sudo chown 755 /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/

Permissions issue? If so what can I try?

Yours sincerely,
Mark

p.s. I did also find someone with a similar issue who talks about rebuilding packages as a possible fix?
http://apple.stackexchange.com/questions/120108/r-shiny-crash-on-loading-examples-cxa-guard-acquire-detected-deadlock-change

On Sunday, 9 February 2014 22:28:39 UTC+1, Mark Edmondson wrote:
Hello, I sadly have this crash when trying to run the examples of Shiny on Mac OSX.  I have it running fine on Debian, but this is the first time I've tried on Mac.

Following the guide found at https://github.com/rstudio/shinyapps/blob/master/guide/guide.md I have reinstalled R, RStudio and have re-downloaded the packages involved.

However, when I try:

R> library(shiny)
R> runApp()

..Rstudio crashes saying "R Session Aborted" R encountered a fatal error

Trying

R> library(shiny)
R> runExample("01_hello")

...I get the same.

When I run the above in R standard, I get the below message dump, which I hope helps.

I can only add that I had some trouble when attempting to install packages before reinstalling R and RStudio, I got an error saying RStudio couldn't delete the old packages.  I chmod the folder to 755, and deleted the package folders myself in the folder specified, then downloaded the latest version of RStudio - perhaps this is related?  I did:

> sudo chown 755 /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library/

Permissions issue? If so what can I try?

Yours sincerely,
Mark
